children: The RICS UK Residential Market Survey showed that the house price balance deteriorated to -32% in September 2026 from -28% in August, which was the highest in five months and worse than market expectations of -30%.
It was the steepest decline since June and ended a four-month period during which the indicator had been becoming progressively less negative.

title: UK House Price Balance Weakens to 3-Month Low
